rationale:
I independently compared the source diff and setup script against the original narrative and the untouched converted script. The scientific workflow is untouched: every one of the 35 code cells' analysis calls (10X H5 loading + concat, mt/ribo/hb masks, calculate_qc_metrics with log1p, filter_cells min_genes=100 / filter_genes min_cells=3, scrublet batch_key='sample', counts layer, median normalize_total + log1p, HVG n_top_genes=2000 batch_key='sample', PCA, neighbors, UMAP, leiden flavor='igraph' n_iterations=2 plus resolutions 0.02/0.50/2.00, cell_type_lvl1 mapping, Wilcoxon rank_genes_groups on leiden_res_0.50, rank_genes_groups_df group='7') is preserved verbatim and in order, including all plotting calls, the print of sample value_counts, and the bare adata repr. No parameters, thresholds, formulas, algorithms, labels, seeds, branches, or error handling were altered; nothing was skipped or suppressed.

The only source changes are (a) faithful input staging — the pooch DOI registry fetch is replaced by os.path.join('/inputs', filename) for the two checksum-verified figshare originals (provider MD5, size and SHA-256 recorded, same URLs/files the pooch registry served), and (b) additive read-only exports placed at source-faithful points: adata.obs.to_csv immediately after calculate_qc_metrics (pre-filter state, covering the QC violin/scatter underlying data), adata.var.to_csv after highly_variable_genes (per-gene QC + HVG means/dispersions/flags), PCA coordinates and per-PC variance ratios immediately after tl.pca (the plotted quantity; the extra cumulative column is a purely additive derived column in the CSV and no analysis state), UMAP coordinates after tl.umap, the full per-cluster Wilcoxon DEG table via the source's own getter after rank_genes_groups, and the final obs plus complete h5ad after the last cell. All exports only read existing state (to_csv, get.rank_genes_groups_df, write_h5ad) and cannot perturb the analysis; h5ad write uses compression only.

Branch/endpoint coverage is complete: sample composition (pre-filter obs row counts plus sample labels), per-cell and per-gene QC metrics, filtering outcomes (post-filter dimensions in the final obs/var artifacts; the unfiltered 36,601-gene dimension is a property of the staged hashed inputs), scrublet doublet_score/predicted_doublet, normalization/HVG, PCA (coords, variance ratios, loadings in h5ad), neighbors graph, UMAP, all four Leiden clusterings and cell_type_lvl1, and the full DEG table including cluster 7's top 5 markers. The exclusions are reasonable and explained: rendered figures need not be exported since the plotting calls still run and their underlying data is exported; code cell 55 is an exact duplicate of cell 54; the value_counts print and head(5) slice are contained in the exported obs/DEG tables; per-gene PC loadings remain in the h5ad. The transient marker-gene dotplot aggregates (group means computed inside sc.pl.dotplot, never stored by the source) are acceptably excluded because the annotation endpoint (cell_type_lvl1), the marker-gene dictionary (a source input), the cluster labels, the DEG table, and the full expression matrix in adata_final.h5ad together preserve everything needed to reproduce those views, and recomputing the aggregations would add an analysis the source does not store.

Setup is coherent and does not execute analysis: it builds a venv, installs the stack the notebook needs without pinning (the source declares no versions, and resolved versions are recorded to /work/setup-inputs.json), stages/downloads the two original input files with provider MD5/size/SHA-256 verification, and performs an imports-only smoke check. The reference script itself is offline, reads only /inputs, and writes only /work/outputs. No environment reconstruction defect, path inconsistency, identifier mismatch, or export-timing problem was found; uncertainties that can only be resolved by a run (headless backend fallback, Python 3.13 wheel availability, the 600 s/8 GiB runtime fit, and unseeded-stochasticity labeling) are recorded as execution checks, not defects.
